verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs describe native 'dbt Projects on Snowflake': managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes covering the full develop/deploy/orchestrate/observe lifecycle, plus a migration guide from dbt Core. Community comments confirm dbt is used on Snowflake in practice; the clustering complaint is a cost caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the native dbt Projects feature specifically, and explicit evidence on the standalone dbt-snowflake adapter docs.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, dbt is a first-class citizen — a documented adapter or native dbt project support with vendor docs to match

citations.quote: dbt Projects on Snowflake brings the full dbt lifecycle into Snowflake: develop, deploy, orchestrate, and observe your transformations in the same place your data already lives.
No infrastructure to manage: Snowflake provides managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes.
Migrating an existing dbt Core project? See the Migrate from dbt Core to dbt Projects on Snowflake.
